_comment: EdgeCDSS — LLM provider and model registry.
This file is CONFIG. Changing a model string, adding a model, or pointing a
provider at a different host is an edit here, not a code change. providers.py
reads it at import; if it is missing or unparseable the built-in defaults in
providers.py are used instead and the reason is printed. See README.md
'Choosing a model'.
providers[].adapter   'openai_compat' speaks the OpenAI chat-completions wire
format and covers OpenAI, Ollama, llama.cpp and vLLM;
'anthropic' uses the native Anthropic SDK.
providers[].base_url_env  env var that overrides base_url at runtime.
providers[].key_prefix    rejected before any network call when it does not
match — catches a pasted key ID or the wrong provider's
key. Omit for self-hosted providers with arbitrary keys.
models[].supports_temperature  false for models that reject sampling params
(Claude Opus 5 / Sonnet 5 return 400). The caller's
temperature is dropped for those models.
models[].effort       Anthropic output_config.effort. null to omit.
models[].reserve_tokens  added to the caller's max_tokens. Models that think
by default spend max_tokens on reasoning before any
visible text, so a 700-token cap can return an empty
string. Reserve gives the answer room.
providers[].requires_key   a hosted provider reached through an OpenAI-
compatibility endpoint ships a real base_url AND needs a key.
Without this flag config_problem() reads 'has a base_url' as
'self-hosted, legitimately keyless' and lets an unconfigured
provider through to a network auth check on every /status poll.
gemini / xai   Both reached through their OpenAI-compatibility endpoints,
so both use the openai_compat adapter and neither needs code.
Model ids below were VERIFIED against the live APIs on
2026-08-22 rather than taken from memory, because model strings
expire: gemini-2.5-pro now returns 404 'no longer available'.
key_prefix is null for both — the OPAQUE-KEY rule. Rejecting a
key by shape before any network call is only safe when the
shape is certain and documented, and it is not for either of
these. requires_key: true still applies, so a missing key is
reported by config_problem() without a network round trip.
VERIFICATION STATE, 2026-08-22. Read this before trusting the
menu: every id below is CORRECT, and two of the three are gated
by ACCOUNT STATE rather than by anything in this file.
gemini-3.7-flash        ROUND-TRIPPED OK, repeatedly, through
providers.chat() and through the full
pipeline. Then the key hit its FREE-TIER
DAILY CAP: quotaId
GenerateRequestsPerDayPerProjectPerModel,
limit 20 per day per model. A 12-query
eval slice exhausts it. Pacing does not
help — the cap is daily, not per minute.
The config is right; the PLAN is a demo
plan.
gemini-3.1-pro-preview  Id correct, NOT round-tripped. Returns
429 'you exceeded your current quota' on
every attempt, including via the
gemini-pro-latest alias. The free tier
does not include the pro tier at all.
grok-4                  Id confirmed to EXIST, NOT round-tripped:
the xAI team has no credits, so every
call returns 403 permission-denied. x.ai
answers 400 'Model not found' for a bogus
name and 403 for a real one, so the 403
IS the name check — grok-3, grok-4,
grok-4-fast and grok-code-fast-1 are all
403s today; grok-2, grok-4.1 and grok-5
are 400s and do not exist.
CONSEQUENCE FOR THE MENU. available_models() gates per PROVIDER,
not per model. xAI fails authentication outright, so grok-4 never
reaches the dropdown — the architecture handles that case exactly
right. Gemini AUTHENTICATES on the free tier, so BOTH gemini
entries are selectable while neither is usable for sustained
traffic, and a medic who picks one gets 'System error. Use local
protocol and contact medical control.' once the cap is hit. That
is fail-closed and it is still a dead menu entry. Fixing it needs
either a paid plan or per-MODEL availability, and per-model
availability means one authenticated call per model on every
/status poll, which is why it is not done here.
grok-4 supports_temperature is FALSE and that is a guess made in
the safe direction. A model that REJECTS the parameter returns
400 on every query; one that accepts it and never sees it just
samples at its own default. Flip to true once a credited key
confirms it, and note the validator is unaffected either way.
reserve_tokens 3000 on all three: they are reasoning-capable
tiers, and the generator's 700-token cap can otherwise be spent
entirely on thinking, returning an empty string. gemini-3.7-flash
was measured returning 142 visible tokens with the reserve.
